HealthSpan Partners, an affiliate of US nonprofit hospital group Bon Secours Mercy Health, has agreed to acquire Bain Capital-backed Surgery Partners in a $5.7bn take-private transaction.

Canada has launched a C$1.75bn venture and growth capital investment programme designed to attract pension funds and other institutional investors into domestic venture capital.

The Pennsylvania Public School Employees' Retirement System has authorised up to $650m of private markets investments and additional commitments, including $200m for Clayton, Dubilier & Rice's thirteenth flagship fund.

Town Lane has closed its second real estate opportunities fund at its $1.9bn hard cap, well above its initial $1.5bn target.

Bison Ventures has raised $160m for its second venture capital fund, approximately 19% more than its debut vehicle, as the US manager increases its exposure to early-stage companies developing frontier technologies.

Vintage Investment Partners has raised $920m across its venture fund-of-funds and secondaries strategies, taking the Tel Aviv-based manager's assets under management above $4.8bn.

Ascertis Credit has secured more than $700m in commitments for its fourth private credit fund, surpassing the $600m raised for its predecessor as the Singapore-based manager continues fundraising towards a $1bn target.

Global private equity assets under management are forecast to almost double to $12tn by the end of 2031, while private credit will surpass $5tn and become one of the fastest-growing major alternative investment classes, according to new research from Preqin.

Partners Group has raised $875m through two rated feeder vehicles for its evergreen private credit strategy this year, following a second closing that secured $510m from US insurance companies.
